title: CRISPR/Cas9 Knockout Strategies to Ablate CCAT1 lncRNA Gene in Cancer Cells
author: Zare, Shademan, et al.
materials: All cell lines were purchased from the National Cell Bank of Iran (Pasteur Institute, Iran) and cultured as recommended by the ATCC. Three colorectal adenocarcinoma cells were used, which differed based on microsatellite stability (MS) and CpG island methylator phenotype (CIMP). HT-29 cells are microsatellite stable (MSS), and CIMP high, SW-480 cells are MSS and CIMP low, and HCT-116 cells show microsatellite instability (MSI) and are CIMP high [33]. HT-29 and SW-480 cells were cultured in RPMI (Biowest, France) supplemented with 10% FBS (Gibco, USA), 50 U/ml penicillin and 50 μg/ml streptomycin (Sigma-Aldrich, USA) at 37 °C in 5% CO2. HCT-116 cells were cultured in DMEM (Gibco, USA) containing 10% FBS and penicillin-streptomycin (50/50 U/ug/ml) at 37 °C in a 5% CO2 environment.

steps.title: Culture colorectal adenocarcinoma cells
steps.instruction: Thaw and expand HT‑29, SW‑480, and HCT‑116 cells. Culture HT‑29 and SW‑480 in RPMI (Biowest, France) supplemented with 10 % FBS (Gibco, USA), 50 U ml⁻¹ penicillin and 50 µg ml⁻¹ streptomycin (Sigma‑Aldrich, USA) at 37 °C in a humidified incubator with 5 % CO₂. Culture HCT‑116 in DMEM (Gibco, USA) containing 10 % FBS and penicillin‑streptomycin at 50 U ml⁻¹/50 µg ml⁻¹ (50/50 U/µg ml⁻¹) under the same temperature and CO₂ conditions.

steps.title: Isolate genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Harvest wild‑type and knockout cells, and isolate genomic DNA using the Genomic DNA Isolation Kit I (DENAzist Asia Co., Iran) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Amplify target region by PCR
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification of the CCAT1 locus (or other target region) using the isolated genomic DNA as template (details of primers and cycling conditions as in Fig. 2).

steps.title: Clean up PCR products
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR‑amplified bands using the clean‑up and reaction‑recovery kit supplied by DENAzist Asia Co., Iran.

steps.title: Submit for Sanger sequencing
steps.instruction: Send the purified PCR products to Macrogen Inc. (South Korea) for Sanger sequencing.

steps.title: Analyze RNA‑seq data with Tuxedo
steps.instruction: Process whole‑transcriptome sequencing data from HT‑29 wild‑type and knockout cells using the Tuxedo pipeline to obtain differential expression results.

steps.title: Select significant DE genes
steps.instruction: Apply the following criteria to the differential expression output: adjusted p‑value < 0.05, absolute fold‑change ≥ 1 (±1‑fold). Retain the 182 genes meeting these thresholds.

steps.title: Perform GO enrichment analysis
steps.instruction: Upload the list of 182 differentially expressed genes to the DAVID web tool (DAVID 6.8, October 2016; http://david.ncifcrf.gov) and run Gene Ontology (GO) term enrichment using the GO Direct category.
